title: Core drawing tools and draggable rounded corners
summary: Draw with Pen, Line and Highlighter, place numbered steps, and round rectangle or callout corners by dragging inward.

Added: Editable Pen, Line and translucent Highlighter with color, opacity, width, movement, resizing and one-gesture Undo.
Numbered or lettered circular steps with next/reset controls, editable labels, size and fill color.
Blue inset corner handles round rectangles and callouts directly while drawing tools remain selected. Drag outward to square them again; size and callout pointer stay fixed.
Session capture delays of 3, 5 or 10 seconds, with a native countdown and cancellation.
Fixed: Continuous arrow coverage removes diagonal seams and composites overlapping segments once.
Verified: 112 Rust tests plus native creation, corner dragging, label editing, sequence reset, Undo, save and exact clipboard checks.
768000 native pixels across drawing, arrows and delayed capture; final optimized reopening and release roundtrip checks accompany the package.
Planning: Original missed roadmap targets stay visible. Unscheduled work no longer receives automatically rolled-forward release numbers. Partial releases are labeled explicitly.

limitations: Per-corner radii, additional shape families, advanced stroke presets and pen pressure remain unfinished.
Step markers currently use circles and automatic text contrast; alternative shapes and independent text color remain planned.
Use alpha.29 or newer for projects containing these new tools or corner radii. Full Snagit interface and behavioral parity are not claimed.
This is an unsigned Windows x64 alpha. Custom shortcuts, scrolling capture and persistent capture preferences remain planned.
